Situation Report — Day 27

  • Active strikes/sirens: Iran launched strikes against targets in Kuwait and Bahrain in response to recent US strikes. Regional alerts and disruptions reported.
  • Northern Border (Lebanon): Hezbollah remains active daily. A Hezbollah operative killed one IDF officer and wounded another in a southern-Lebanon operation. Supporter riots reported after the Israel-Lebanon agreement. IDF pulled back slightly — described as first test of the Lebanon deal.
  • Gulf / Strait of Hormuz: Iran permits passage for Russia, India, China; blocks others. CENTCOM says two weekend Hormuz targets were newly built Iranian facilities. Tension over freedom of navigation persists.
  • Air campaign & airspace: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iran continue (previous strikes hit Isfahan and Khorramshahr). Major regional airports currently closed: Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan. Flight scans show elevated military air traffic.
  • Diplomacy / pauses: Trump announced a 10-day SECOND pause on Iran energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026, 8 PM ET), citing an Iranian request. Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. First 5-day pause was violated hours after it began.
  • Domestic / other: Police seized a stolen IDF shoulder-fired anti-tank rocket launcher in the south. Israel opened partial operations on the Eastern Rail Line (three new stations).
  • 🟢 Good News: Eastern Rail Line partially opened; stolen AT launcher recovered.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.

Situation Report — Day 27 (last 6 hours)

  • Active strikes and missile barrages ongoing: Iranian strikes on Kuwait and Bahrain; US/Israeli airstrikes near Strait of Hormuz and inside Iran; daily Hezbollah fire from Lebanon. IDF officer killed in southern Lebanon operation.
  • Hormuz & Iranian strikes: Iran permits passage only for Russia, India, China; blocks other ships. CENTCOM/US struck targets near Hormuz — two targets were newly built Iranian sites. Iran claims US violated agreements.
  • US-Israel campaign: Trump announced a SECOND 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET), saying talks “going very well.” Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. Note: first pause (Mar 23, 5 days) was violated hours later by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Gulf impact: Kuwait intercepted two ballistic missiles. Bahrain reports a residential building damaged. Cross-border missile/rocket activity continues.
  • Northern Border — Lebanon/Hezbollah: Daily Hezbollah activity. Hezbollah terrorist killed an IDF officer and wounded another during a southern Lebanon operation. Supporter rioting reported after Lebanon agreement.
  • Domestic & transport: Airports closed across Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan. Ben-Gurion Terminal 1 reopened for domestic flights. Flight-tracking shows continued military flights in the region.
  • Security finds: Israeli police seized a stolen shoulder‑mounted anti-tank rocket launcher from criminals in the south.
  • International action: Pakistan mediating. Russia/India/China granted Hormuz passage — significant tactical favor to Tehran. No new Western deployments reported in this window.
  • 🟢 Good News: Kuwait intercepted missiles. Ben-Gurion partial reopening. Police seizure removed a ready weapon from criminal circulation.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating — high risk of continued cross-border strikes and wider regional involvement.

Situation Report — Day 27

    • Ben-Gurion Terminal 1 reopened to domestic flights.

    • Trump announced a SECOND pause on energy-targeted strikes: 10 days, deadline Apr 6, 2026 20:00 ET; said Iran requested pause. Iran denies direct talks.

  • International Actions
    • Selective maritime access for Russia/India/China is a concrete shift in naval posture and trade routes.
  • Good News
    • Multiple ballistic missiles intercepted in Kuwait/Bahrain.
    • Ben-Gurion partially reopened for domestic flights.
    • Pakistan mediation ongoing — a channel for deconfliction.

Threat assessment: escalating.
